boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten source-backed, under-21-safe places and activities with no admission or purchase required; campus options note Ithaca College access limits.

cards.entity_name: Ithaca College Fitness Center Exercise Area
cards.title: Use the Fitness Center Exercise Area
cards.subtitle: Fitness Center · Ithaca College campus
cards.notes: Bring your Ithaca College ID, choose cardio or strength equipment, and make a casual workout plan with a friend during posted facility hours.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost campus workout space for IC community members.
cards.evidence_claim: Ithaca College states that students, faculty, and staff can use their ID cards for free access to Fitness Center equipment and facilities.
cards.access_notes: For Ithaca College students, faculty, and staff with a valid IC ID during posted hours.

cards.title: Join a Group Exercise Class
cards.subtitle: Fitness Center Aerobics Room · Ithaca College campus
cards.notes: Check the current class schedule, sign up through IMLeagues or at the desk, and arrive ready for the listed movement class.
cards.short_summary: Scheduled group movement classes for the campus community.
cards.evidence_claim: Ithaca College says all group exercise classes are free of charge and open to all members of its campus community.
cards.access_notes: Campus-community access; class availability and sign-up details vary by semester.

cards.title: Climb at the IC Climbing Wall
cards.subtitle: Fitness Center · Ithaca College campus
cards.notes: Go during supervised open-wall hours, follow attendant instructions, and use the shoes, chalk, and harnesses the facility provides.
cards.short_summary: An indoor climbing session with campus-provided gear.
cards.evidence_claim: Ithaca College lists the Climbing Wall among Fitness Center facilities available through free ID-based access for students, faculty, and staff.
cards.access_notes: For IC students, faculty, and staff with ID; climb only during supervised open hours.

cards.title: Check Out Gear for a Pickup Game
cards.subtitle: Fitness Center · Ithaca College campus
cards.notes: Ask at the Fitness Center for a basketball, indoor soccer ball, jump rope, or badminton racquet, then use an available recreation space.
cards.short_summary: Free equipment checkout makes an impromptu game easy.
cards.evidence_claim: Ithaca College says valid-ID campus-community members may rent basketballs, indoor soccer balls, jump ropes, and badminton racquets free of charge.
cards.access_notes: Valid Ithaca College ID required; use follows Fitness Center rules and space availability.

cards.title: Watch for an IC After Dark Program
cards.subtitle: Ithaca College campus
cards.notes: Check campus event listings for the next monthly program and attend with friends for an alcohol-free late-night activity on campus.
cards.short_summary: Monthly alternative entertainment organized for the campus community.
cards.evidence_claim: Ithaca College describes IC After Dark as hosting monthly alternative programs open to the campus community and providing free late-night entertainment.
cards.source_title: Drug-Free Schools and Communities Act Annual Notification 2026 | Ithaca College
cards.access_notes: Open to the campus community; consult the campus calendar for each program’s location and timing.

cards.entity_name: Herbert F. Johnson Museum of Art
cards.title: Browse the Johnson Museum Galleries
cards.subtitle: 114 Central Avenue · Cornell University, Ithaca
cards.notes: Plan around the museum’s current hours, move through the galleries at your own pace, and use the visit page for accessibility details.
cards.short_summary: A public art museum with free admission.
cards.evidence_claim: The Herbert F. Johnson Museum of Art states that admission for everyone is always free.
cards.source_title: Visit | Herbert F. Johnson Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Open to everyone during posted museum hours; parking may be separately metered.

cards.title: Pause at the Morgan Japanese Garden
cards.subtitle: Johnson Museum · Cornell University, Ithaca
cards.notes: Walk the wooden pathway beside the garden, stay off planted areas, and pair the stop with a visit to the adjacent museum galleries.
cards.short_summary: A small exterior Japanese garden beside the Johnson Museum.
cards.evidence_claim: The Johnson Museum says the Morgan Japanese Garden is always open to visitors, and the museum has free admission for all.
cards.source_title: The Museum | Herbert F. Johnson Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Exterior garden is open to visitors; seasonal maintenance closures may occur.

cards.title: Wander the Nevin Welcome Center Gardens
cards.subtitle: Cornell Botanic Gardens · Ithaca
cards.notes: Use the welcome center as a starting point, explore the surrounding gardens from dawn to dusk, and check seasonal building hours before arriving.
cards.short_summary: Public gardens at Cornell Botanic Gardens’ visitor hub.
cards.evidence_claim: Cornell Botanic Gardens states that all of its gardens and natural areas are free and open to the public year-round.
cards.access_notes: Gardens are free from dawn to dusk; weekday daytime parking near Nevin may be metered.

cards.title: Walk the F. R. Newman Arboretum
cards.subtitle: Cornell Botanic Gardens · Ithaca
cards.notes: Choose a walking loop among the trees, bring water, and stay on marked paths while exploring during daylight hours with a friend.
cards.short_summary: An arboretum walk with free grounds and parking.
cards.evidence_claim: Cornell Botanic Gardens states that its gardens and natural areas are free and open to the public, and that Newman Arboretum parking is free.
cards.access_notes: Grounds are free from dawn to dusk; the official FAQ identifies Arboretum parking as free.

cards.title: Stroll the Mundy Wildflower Garden
cards.subtitle: Cornell Botanic Gardens · Ithaca
cards.notes: Visit during daylight, take a slow loop to identify seasonal plants, and keep the group on paths so the garden remains protected.
cards.evidence_claim: Cornell Botanic Gardens states that its gardens and natural areas are free and open to the public, and that Mundy Wildflower Garden parking is free.
cards.access_notes: Grounds are free from dawn to dusk; the official FAQ identifies Mundy Wildflower Garden parking as free.
